summary: VP Deepotsav lead, NZ polling day, SEBI rules, Punjab paddy, Delhi AQI, WHO; 2 held by the editor

fixed_by_run.why: The time conversion is wrong in both languages. 'About 95% of the preliminary party vote by 11:30 pm, which is about 4 am IST on Sunday' (Hindi: 'रविवार तड़के करीब 4 बजे') cannot be right: NZDT is 7.5 hours ahead of IST, so 11:30 pm NZDT is 4 pm IST on Saturday. The story's own 7 pm NZDT = 11:30 am IST shows this. Polls also close at 11:30 am IST, under an hour from now.
fixed_by_run.fix: In EN and HI, change 'about 4 am IST on Sunday' to 'about 4 pm IST on Saturday' (Hindi: 'भारतीय समय के अनुसार शनिवार शाम करीब 4 बजे'). The 10 pm (50% of voting places) and 11:30 pm (95%) targets match The Spinoff, so leave them. After 11:30 am IST, rewrite it as a results story with the first preliminary figures.
fixed_by_run.done: Changed to about 4 pm IST on Saturday in English and Hindi.
